title: Every module extension unit is a scalar telescope colimit
statement: For each integral coefficient module M on X, the scalar-localization unit cocone with vertex restriction of extension of M to continuous E coefficients is colimiting. Definitions and notation: [def-weil-pbc-integral-localization-telescope].

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), referring to Bhatt–Scholze Lemma 6.8.2; scalar localization telescope

proof.text: Tensor the regular coefficient telescope with M. Tensor preserves colimits; identify its source with M using the left unitor and its vertex with restricted extension using the existing private extendComapTensorIso of ContinuousConstructibleIntegralDenominators. Its existing extendUnit_tensor theorem identifies the zeroth leg with the actual extension unit. Reuse module_nsmul_isIso from ContinuousConstructibleIntegralImage for invertibility at the vertex; leg determination then identifies every leg with the canonical unit cocone. The tensor API is reused through proof-only import all; the scalar theorem is made public so exposed cocone definitions can use it. No construction or proof is duplicated.

theorem integralModuleLocalization_isColimit (X : Scheme.{u})
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (integralModuleLocalizationCocone ℓ E X M))
